app.title: Wait or Switch
app.description: When trains stop, see whether to wait or switch, with an estimate and what to do next.

disclaimer.short: This is an estimate. Always follow official announcements.

start.lead: Choose where you are and where you are going. When service is suspended, we estimate whether to wait or switch.
start.locateFailed: Could not get your location. Please choose a station.
start.locateUnsupported: Location is not available on this device. Please choose a station.

situation.heading: What is happening now?
situation.lead: We read the current phase from signs and announcements.

photo.hint: Take a photo of a station notice or information display.
photo.unsupported: This image could not be read. Please try another photo.

paste.label: Announcement or notice text
paste.placeholder: e.g. Service is suspended due to a person struck by a train

select.signalLabel: What did you hear or see? (choose any)
select.empty: Choices are not ready yet. Please use a photo or paste text.

error.title: Could not get a judgment
error.retryable: Check your connection and try again.

breakEven.title: Break-even time
breakEven.noneDetail: With the current estimate, waiting and switching do not swap places in arrival time.

options.title: Options
options.note: Ride times and fares are approximate.

evidence.title: Why this judgment
evidence.unknownPhase: The phase could not be identified

addInfo.title: Add information
addInfo.lead: If there is a new notice or announcement, add it to update the judgment.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.p1: Service updates tell you what happened. This app goes on to tell you what you should do.
purpose.p2: When service is suspended, it shows an estimate and an action to help you decide whether to wait or switch.

approach.title: How we estimate
approach.p1: We use knowledge from a former train dispatcher, generalized into signs anyone can observe.
approach.p2: We read signals from the notices you bring and estimate the current phase and a range for the time to resumption.
approach.p3: Numbers such as arrival and break-even times are computed by code. The AI interprets and explains them.
approach.p4: When we are not confident, we focus on the break-even time instead of a firm estimate.

attribution.title: Sources
attribution.map: Map: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan / © OpenStreetMap contributors
attribution.rail: Railway data: processed from National Land Numerical Information (Railway), MLIT Japan

notes.title: Notes
notes.p1: Everything shown is an estimate. Follow official announcements and station staff first.
notes.p2: We do not fetch railway service information automatically. Judgments are based on what you enter.
notes.p3: Ride times and fares are approximate and may differ from actual ones.
notes.p4: Your location and input are used only for the judgment and are not stored.
